
Additivity

```{r}
# Build models with and without interactions
model_additive <- lm(mpg ~ cyl + hp + wt, data = mtcars_clean)
model_interaction <- lm(mpg ~ cyl * hp * wt, data = mtcars_clean)

# Compare models using ANOVA
cat("### Model Comparison: Additive vs. Interaction Model\n\n")
anova_result <- anova(model_additive, model_interaction)
print(anova_result)

cat("\n### Interpretation:\n")
p_value <- anova_result$`Pr(>F)`
if(!is.na(p_value) && p_value < 0.05) {
  cat("p-value =", round(p_value, 4), "< 0.05\n")
  cat("**Conclusion:** Interaction terms are significant. Additivity assumption is VIOLATED.\n")
  cat("However, for simplicity, we proceed with additive model but acknowledge limitations.\n")
} else {
  cat("p-value =", round(p_value, 4), "> 0.05\n")
  cat("**Conclusion:** Interaction terms are NOT significant. Additivity assumption is MET.\n")
  cat("Variables combine additively in predicting MPG.\n")
}

# Visualize potential interactions
ggplot(mtcars_clean, aes(x = wt, y = mpg, color = factor(cyl))) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
  labs(title = "Interaction Check: Weight × Cylinders on MPG",
       x = "Weight (1000 lbs)",
       y = "Miles per Gallon",
       color = "Cylinders") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

```

Linearity

```{r}
# Scatter plots for each IV vs DV
p1 <- ggplot(mtcars_clean, aes(x = cyl, y = mpg)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = "blue", alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "red") +
  labs(title = "MPG vs. Cylinders",
       x = "Number of Cylinders",
       y = "Miles per Gallon") +
  theme_minimal()

p2 <- ggplot(mtcars_clean, aes(x = hp, y = mpg)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = "darkgreen", alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "red") +
  labs(title = "MPG vs. Horsepower",
       x = "Horsepower",
       y = "Miles per Gallon") +
  theme_minimal()

p3 <- ggplot(mtcars_clean, aes(x = wt, y = mpg)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = "purple", alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "red") +
  labs(title = "MPG vs. Weight",
       x = "Weight (1000 lbs)",
       y = "Miles per Gallon") +
  theme_minimal()

grid.arrange(p1, p2, p3, nrow = 2,
             top = "Linearity Assessment: Scatter Plots with Linear Fit")

# Correlation matrix
cat("\n### Correlation Analysis:\n")
cor_matrix <- cor(mtcars_clean %>% select(mpg, cyl, hp, wt))
print(round(cor_matrix, 3))

# Visualize correlation matrix
corrplot(cor_matrix, method = "color", type = "upper", 
         addCoef.col = "black", tl.col = "black", tl.srt = 45,
         title = "Correlation Matrix: Linearity Assessment",
         mar = c(0,0,2,0))

```

```{r}
cat("\n### Linearity Interpretation:\n\n")
cat("Correlation coefficients:\n")
cat("- mpg ~ cyl: r =", round(cor(mtcars_clean$mpg, mtcars_clean$cyl), 3), "\n")
cat("- mpg ~ hp:  r =", round(cor(mtcars_clean$mpg, mtcars_clean$hp), 3), "\n")
cat("- mpg ~ wt:  r =", round(cor(mtcars_clean$mpg, mtcars_clean$wt), 3), "\n\n")

cat("All correlations are substantial (|r| > 0.7), indicating strong linear relationships.\n")
cat("Scatter plots show relatively linear patterns without obvious curvilinear trends.\n\n")
cat("**Conclusion:** Linearity assumption is REASONABLY MET.\n")

```

Normality

```{r}
# Fit the regression model
model <- lm(mpg ~ cyl + hp + wt, data = mtcars_clean)

# Extract residuals
residuals <- residuals(model)

# Shapiro-Wilk test
shapiro_test <- shapiro.test(residuals)

cat("### Shapiro-Wilk Normality Test:\n")
cat("Test Statistic (W):", round(shapiro_test$statistic, 4), "\n")
cat("p-value:", round(shapiro_test$p.value, 4), "\n\n")

if(shapiro_test$p.value > 0.05) {
  cat("**Conclusion:** p >0.05. We FAIL TO REJECT the null hypothesis.\n")
  cat("Residuals are approximately normally distributed. Normality assumption is MET.\n")
} else {
  cat("**Conclusion:** p < 0.05. We REJECT the null hypothesis.\n")
  cat("Residuals deviate from normality. Normality assumption is VIOLATED.\n")
  cat("Note: With small sample sizes (n=32), minor deviations are common.\n")
}

```

```{r}
# Q-Q plot
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))

# Q-Q plot
qqnorm(residuals, main = "Q-Q Plot: Normality Assessment")
qqline(residuals, col = "red", lwd = 2)

# Histogram of residuals
hist(residuals, breaks = 10, col = "lightblue", border = "black",
     main = "Histogram of Residuals",
     xlab = "Residuals", prob = TRUE)
lines(density(residuals), col = "red", lwd = 2)
curve(dnorm(x, mean = mean(residuals), sd = sd(residuals)), 
      add = TRUE, col = "blue", lwd = 2, lty = 2)
legend("topright", c("Actual", "Normal"), col = c("red", "blue"), 
       lty = c(1, 2), lwd = 2)

# Residuals vs Fitted
plot(fitted(model), residuals,
     main = "Residuals vs. Fitted Values",
     xlab = "Fitted Values", ylab = "Residuals",
     pch = 19, col = "darkgreen")
abline(h = 0, col = "red", lwd = 2, lty = 2)

# Box plot of residuals
boxplot(residuals, col = "lightyellow", main = "Boxplot of Residuals",
        ylab = "Residuals")
abline(h = 0, col = "red", lwd = 2, lty = 2)

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

```
